title: FedCGR: Federated Cross-Domain Generative Recommendation
abstract_en: Cross-domain recommendation (CDR) transfers preference knowledge across related domains, but federated deployment makes cross-domain alignment difficult because the behavioral anchors that align item spaces, such as overlapping users and shared interaction signals, are often sparse, unavailable, or privacy-sensitive across clients. To address this tension, we revisit federated CDR as generation over a stable semantic item language. By representing items as discrete semantic ID (SID) sequences derived from public item-side metadata, cross-domain item alignment is induced by a shared vocabulary rather than by exchanging private interactions or aligning domain-specific embeddings. Directly federating SID-based generators, however, introduces two design constraints: the SID tokenizer must remain fixed to preserve cross-client token consistency, which creates a semantic-only bottleneck because local collaborative filtering (CF) signals cannot be globally shared or aligned; meanwhile, standard federated averaging can cause negative transfer under domain heterogeneity. To overcome these constraints, we propose FedCGR, a federated generative CDR framework that keeps the item language stable and makes adaptation explicit. FedCGR injects local CF evidence through a reliability-aware semantic interface and trains a prototype-personalized generator that selectively aggregates shared parameters according to domain relatedness while keeping domain-specific quantities local. Experiments on six Amazon cross-domain scenarios show that FedCGR consistently outperforms federated generative baselines and achieves competitive performance against strong sequential and federated CDR methods under both full-ranking and sampled evaluation protocols.
abstract_zh: 本文研究联邦场景下的跨域推荐（CDR）问题。传统 CDR 依赖重叠用户、共享交互信号等行为锚点来对齐不同领域的物品空间，但在联邦部署中，这些信号往往稀疏、不可用或涉及隐私。FedCGR 将联邦 CDR 重新表述为基于稳定语义物品语言的生成任务：利用公开物品侧元数据构建离散语义 ID（SID）序列，使跨域物品对齐由共享词表诱导，而无需交换私有交互或对齐领域专属 embedding。针对固定 SID tokenizer 带来的语义瓶颈，以及 FedAvg 在领域异质性下可能导致负迁移的问题，FedCGR 通过可靠性感知的语义接口注入本地协同过滤（CF）证据，并训练原型个性化生成器，根据领域相关性选择性聚合共享参数，同时将领域特定信息保留在本地。在六个 Amazon 跨域推荐场景上的实验表明，FedCGR 稳定优于联邦生成式推荐基线，并在 full-ranking 与 sampled evaluation 两种协议下，与强序列推荐和联邦 CDR 方法相比具有竞争力。
key_points_zh: 提出 FedCGR，将联邦跨域推荐转化为基于离散语义 ID（SID）序列的生成式推荐，利用公开物品元数据构建跨域共享物品语言。
避免依赖重叠用户、共享交互等隐私敏感行为锚点，通过共享 SID vocabulary 实现跨客户端、跨领域的语义对齐。
设计可靠性感知语义接口，将本地协同过滤（CF）信号注入固定 SID 语义表示，缓解纯语义 tokenizer 带来的信息瓶颈。
引入原型个性化生成器，根据领域相关性选择性聚合共享参数，减少 FedAvg 在领域异质性下的负迁移。
在六个 Amazon 跨域场景中，FedCGR 优于联邦生成式基线，并在 full-ranking 与 sampled evaluation 下达到强竞争性能。

llm_assessment.comment: A strong federated cross-domain product recommendation paper grounded in Amazon scenarios with clear serving and privacy relevance.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作以 Amazon 跨域推荐为核心，兼具联邦隐私部署价值和明确的商品推荐意义。
